integrity_notes: Uniform free-pair proof for both edge orbits; independently regenerated finite complexes, complete boundary matrices, and all explicit free pairs for \(9\le n\le64\). Executable checks corroborate rather than replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: For \(n\ge9\) and one graph edge only; no assertion about smaller graphs, multiple faults, equivariance, or naturality of the collapses. Novelty is assessed against inspected sources, not exhaustive literature. No independent audit.
title: A single edge punctures the squared-cycle neighborhood torus twice
